# Axum Playground

> A local Rust/Axum reference REST API with JSON/CBOR, Firebase-owned profiles,
> cursor pagination, and anonymous read-only GitHub projections.

This application is not deployed. GCP is a possible future target. From the
repository root, create `.env` from `.env.example` if absent, then run `just run`;
the default local origin is `http://localhost:8080`. Public operations and
documentation work without Google credentials. Profiles need `just emulators`
and a local Firebase ID token, as described in the complete guide.

From a running application's origin, retrieve `/.well-known/api-catalog` and
resolve its root-relative links against that retrieval URL. The catalog links
the runtime OpenAPI contract, both guides, and health. `/health` advertises the
catalog and schema through typed HTTP links. These public documents grant no
access to protected operations.

## API usage

- [Complete usage guide](llms-full.txt): Curated, self-contained reference for broad or offline retrieval, including requests, profile CRUD, local credentials, and recovery.
- [Local runtime OpenAPI](http://localhost:8080/openapi.json): Contract for the default local server; replace the origin when running elsewhere. No generated specification is committed.
- [README examples](https://github.com/janisto/axum-playground/blob/main/README.md): Human onboarding and emulator commands.

## Implementation reference

- [Application composition](https://github.com/janisto/axum-playground/blob/main/src/app.rs): Middleware ordering and public/protected routing.
- [Documentation routes](https://github.com/janisto/axum-playground/blob/main/src/http/discovery.rs): Same-build embedded guides and RFC 9727 catalog.
- [Versioned routes](https://github.com/janisto/axum-playground/blob/main/src/http/v1/mod.rs): Greetings, items, GitHub, and current-principal profiles.
- [Authentication](https://github.com/janisto/axum-playground/blob/main/src/auth/mod.rs): Firebase bearer verification and ownership context.
- [Persistence](https://github.com/janisto/axum-playground/blob/main/src/services/profile.rs): Atomic profile lifecycle and transactional updates.
- [OpenAPI projection](https://github.com/janisto/axum-playground/blob/main/src/http/v1/docs.rs): Runtime Utoipa schemas, constraints, and Swagger UI wiring.
